facts.fact: The Plan National du Numérique says the government defined a sector policy document (Document de Politique Sectorielle, DPS) for telecommunications and ICT in 2009, referenced in its bibliography as dated July 2009.

The Plan National du Numérique says the DPS lapsed on expiry of its five-year period without the review being carried out; the end year 2014 is five years from the 2009 adoption, the document giving no year.

systems.country_label: Document de Politique Sectorielle: Stratégie de développement du secteur des Télécommunications et des TIC de la RDC
systems.owner: Ministère des Postes, Téléphones et Télécommunications
Cabinet du Chef de l'État (Cadre de Concertation)

note: The 2019 text states the ICT sector has had no updated sector strategic framework since the 2009 DPS; the Plan itself is a national digital plan, class national, so gives no sector fact.
